_about: Which models Gnosis thinks with. Read by bridge/models.mjs and bridge/sdk.mjs. Keys come from environment variables, never this file.

local._tools: The small on-device model only gets these: every tool schema costs it time and accuracy.

private._about: Private work thinks on the laptop (the local role) and is blanked from what the cloud model sees later. A request is private when it says so, or once one of these tools has read the owner's own data in it.
private.words: \b(?:privately|in private|private mode|keep (?:it|this|that) private|(?:it|this|that)'?s private|offline|on (?:the|my) laptop only)\b
